Usage
=====

Once installed, the program can be run directly from the command line::

    MASSA_Algorithm -i <input_file>.sdf -o <output_file>.sdf

Required arguments
------------------

* **Input file**: ``-i`` or ``--input``
  
  MASSA Algorithm accepts input files in the formats: .sdf, .mol, .mol2, .xlsx, .xls, and .csv. However, the .sdf format is preferred. Notes:
  
  * .mol2 files have limitations in storing molecular properties and follow different saving patterns. Only .mol2 files generated by Discovery Studio Visualizer are supported.
  * For .xlsx, .xls, and .csv files:
    
    * MASSA will look for a column with "smiles" in the name and use it as the source of input molecules.
    * MASSA will look for a column with one of the following names in priority order: Molecule name, Name, Molecule ChEMBL ID, or ID. If none of these columns are found, it will use the molecule index.

* **Output file**: ``-o`` or ``--output``
  
  Enter the output file name or file path. Image files will be saved to a folder within the same directory as the output file. It is highly recommended to use an .sdf file to avoid errors.

Optional arguments
------------------

* **Splitting strategy**: ``-y`` or ``--splitting_strategy``
  
  Defines the splitting strategy: either into training and test sets or into training, test, and validation sets.
  
  Options: ``tt``, ``tt-val``
  
  * ``tt``: split into training and test sets.
  * ``tt-val``: split into training, test, and validation sets.
  
  Default: ``tt``

* **Percentage of molecules in training set**: ``-p`` or ``--percentage_of_training``
  
  Percentage of molecules in the training set. Must be a number from 0 to 1.
  
  Default: 0.8

* **Number of biological activities for separation**: ``-b`` or ``--number_of_biological``
  
  Number of biological activities used to separate the set into training and test.
  
  Default: 1

* **Name of biological activities for separation**: ``-s`` or ``--the_biological_activities``
  
  Biological activity(ies) or other y-property(ies) used for QSAR or machine learning modeling. The algorithm can handle one or more properties. Enter a comma-separated list without spaces. These properties must be integers or floating-point numbers. If your dataset is categorical (e.g., active/inactive), represent them as integers.
  
  Example::
  
      MASSA_Algorithm -i <input_file>.sdf -o <output_file>.sdf -s pIC50,pMIC
  
  Default: requested during algorithm execution if not provided

* **Number of principal components in PCA**: ``-n`` or ``--number_of_PCs``
  
  Defines the number of principal components to reduce the dimensionality of variables. 
  
  * If between 0 and 1, it represents the fraction of explained variance.
  * If greater than 1, the number of PCs is exactly the input integer, but note:
    1. If the number of PCs ≥ number of physicochemical properties (7), PCA is bypassed for this domain.
    2. Same applies to the biological domain.
    3. If the number of biological activities < 3, PCA is bypassed for this domain.
  
  Default: 0.85

* **SVD solver parameter for PCA**: ``-v`` or ``--svd_solver_for_PCA``
  
  See `sklearn.decomposition.PCA <https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.decomposition.PCA.html>`_ for more info.
  
  Default: ``full``

* **HCA linkage method**: ``-l`` or ``--linkage_method``
  
  Linkage criterion for hierarchical clustering. Options: ``complete``, ``single``, ``ward``, ``average``, ``weighted``, ``centroid``, ``median``.
  
  More info: `scipy.cluster.hierarchy.linkage <https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.cluster.hierarchy.linkage.html>`_
  
  Default: ``complete``

* **Extension of image files**: ``-t`` or ``--image_type``
  
  Extension of generated image files (suggested: png, svg)
  
  Default: ``png``

* **Font size for X-axis of dendrograms**: ``-d`` or ``--dendrogram_Xfont_size``
  
  Default: 5

* **Font size for X-axis of bar plots**: ``-x`` or ``--barplot_Xfont_size``
  
  Default: 12

* **Enable Dendrogram plot**: ``-f`` or ``--dendrogram_plot``
  
  Generate dendrogram images.
  
  Options: ``true`` (generate), ``false`` (do not generate)
  
  Default: ``true``

* **Ignore Errors**: ``-e`` or ``--drop_errors``
  
  Ignore chemistry errors and save only molecules without errors.
  
  Options: ``true`` (ignore and log errors), ``false`` (treat errors as fatal)
  
  Default: ``true``

* **Large Dataset**: ``-a`` or ``--large_dataset``
  
  Switch from HCA to MiniBatch-KMeans for large datasets.
  
  Options: ``auto`` (switch if ≥ 10,000 molecules), ``false`` (use HCA), ``true`` (use KMeans)
  
  Default: ``auto``

Command line help
-----------------

A full description of arguments can also be viewed from the command line::

    MASSA_Algorithm -h

or::

    MASSA_Algorithm --help
